mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_token, user_id, quiz_set_id, current_index, answers_json, updated_at FROM quiz_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND quiz_set_id = #{quizSetId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE quiz_progress SET current_index = #{currentIndex}, answers_json = #{answersJson}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, user_id = #{userId}, owner_token = #{ownerToken} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM quiz_progress WHERE owner_token = #{ownerToken} AND quiz_set_id = #{quizSetId}
DELETE FROM quiz_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND quiz_set_id = #{quizSetId}

DELETE p FROM quiz_progress p INNER JOIN quiz_progress cloud ON cloud.quiz_set_id = p.quiz_set_id AND cloud.user_id = #{userId} AND cloud.id <> p.id WHERE p.owner_token = #{ownerToken} AND p.user_id IS NULL
